summary.text:
Let me analyze each visual item comparing reference and candidate.

V09 (walnut variant): Reference: no header visible (starts with breadcrumb), thumbnail column on left, product image, right panel with price, color swatches (two rows, 7 + 6 + "+12"), Add to bag. Candidate: includes full header/nav, image slightly different aspect, swatch grid shows 7 first row + 6 second row without "+12" tile (instead one shows image), "18% off" vs "17% off", title one line different layout, scroll position differences. Overall structure, proportions, images, hierarchy match well. Minor differences: swatch "+12" missing, discount 18 vs 17, header visible. Score 0.75 or 1? "主要结构、比例、图片、层级和样式吻合" = 1. Differences: minor local differences like swatch count display, percentage text (content, not really structural). The 17% vs 18% is a content text difference. Swatch grid: reference has +12 overflow tile, candidate shows a room-image swatch instead. These are small local differences → 0.75 seems appropriate? Layout correct, few local differences → .75. I'd say 0.75.

V10 (bag): Reference: two line items BESTÅ then STUBBARP, qty 1 each, prices, order summary right. Candidate: header shows white background (ref has black top bar), item order reversed (STUBBARP first, BESTÅ second), BESTÅ qty 2 (ref 1), order summary matches well ($260 total both). Structure matches: delivery options row, items, quantity steppers, right summary, checkout button. Differences: header bar color, item order, quantity, assembly row differences (candidate shows $5.20 vs $58.50), BESTÅ title layout. Still clearly same page with correct key layout, several local differences → 0.75.

V11 (bag components drawer): Reference: dimmed background, right drawer with BESTÅ, "made up of 6 parts", list of parts with quantities, dividers. Candidate: same drawer, same 6 parts, same quantities. Differences: part descriptions differ slightly (reference "Frame, black-brown, 47 1/4x15 3/4x25 1/4", candidate "Frame, black-brown" without dimensions; "Support leg, gray" vs "black-brown"; "Door, brown/walnut effect" vs "black-brown"). Background content differs (candidate scrolled position, different bag state) but that's behind the drawer. Structure, spacing, dividers match. Minor text differences → 0.75 or 1. Descriptions truncated differently — small local differences. 0.75? The criteria: 背景遮罩、右侧部件清单、数量和间距 — all match. Text detail differences are minor. Could be 1 but "Support leg, gray, 3 7/8"" vs "Support leg, black-brown" is content difference. I'll give 0.75.

V12 (reviews drawer): Reference: two-column modal — left column rating 3.7, distribution bars, sub-scores, Write a review button; right column "Customer reviews" title, Filter/Sort by buttons, tabs, AI summary, topics chips, review content. Candidate: single-column centered layout — 3.7 centered at top, bars below, sub-scores, Write a review, "Customer reviews" title at bottom left, close X in middle-left. Major layout differences: not two-column, no Filter/Sort buttons visible, no tabs, no review content/summary visible, close button misplaced. It's recognizable as same state but multiple obvious differences and important sections (review list, filter/sort) missing → 0.5. "可辨认同页面但有多处明显差异或一个重要部分缺失" = 0.5. Yes, 0.5.
